run_model_vggt_inference: run the VGGT model on images in a target directory and return predictions including depth, pose, and world points
handle_uploads_video_images: handle uploaded video or images by extracting frames and copying them into a timestamped target directory
gradio_demo_reconstruction: perform 3D reconstruction from uploaded images using VGGT and generate a GLB visualization file
update_visualization_glb: update the 3D visualization by reloading saved predictions and regenerating the GLB with new filter parameters
update_gallery_on_upload: update the image gallery preview when user uploads or changes video or image files
